column4: Low view from behind the living librarian (second reference) standing before the tall stained-glass icon window of the first reference, which towers over her. She raises the large black dressmaker shears high above her head in both hands, blades closed like a dagger, ready to strike the glass. No text.

Close-up of the stained-glass icon window (first reference): the point of large black dressmaker shears has struck the glass at the icon's chest; a star of sharp straight cracks radiates out across the leaded panes. Only the shears tip and the glass. No text.
